summary: Tractor Supply Company filed an 8-K reporting a $500 million offering of 5.200% Senior Notes due 2032 under an existing Form S-3 shelf. The Notes were sold via an underwriting agreement with Wells Fargo and BofA, issued August 25, 2026, governed by a supplemental indenture. Proceeds will repay borrowings under its credit facility and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. No special-situation event or strategic action is present, so the filing is classified as None.
